meta.title: British Columbia domestic layer — consolidated candidates (v5 practical-closure polish)
meta.scope: Full BC domestic layer under DATA SPEC v2 + expanded schema. Assessment spine (Acts, annual roll, Data Advice, Non-Market Change, service-plan report), provincial fiscal core (Budget & Fiscal Plan, Public Accounts), BC Stats core series, school tax, Local Government Statistics (LGDE compilation), Small Community Grants, major Crowns (ICBC, BC Hydro, WorkSafeBC, MFA), regional (Metro Vancouver, CRD, TransLink), and municipal layer with geographic contrast (Metro Vancouver municipalities, Capital Region, Fraser Valley, Interior, North).
meta.notes: Primary sources only. Relationship types restricted to methodology_depends_on | uses_data_from | calculated_from | cites. All edges carry a real evidence quote or explicit statutory/financial-statement link. BC Assessment remains the single province-wide assessment authority; no Alberta-style FIR system exists. v3 adds the provincial municipal-financial-statistics product (closest to Alberta FIR compilation), the education property-tax mechanism, and the assessment-weighted unconditional grant formula. v4 residual pass adds WorkSafeBC (major Crown service-plan/annual-report pair), Abbotsford (Fraser Valley) and Kamloops (Interior) for geographic contrast, and the operational Data Advice feed that delivers the assessment roll to taxing authorities.
meta.philosophy_note: Density relative to other countries or provinces is not a stopping rule and is not a quality criterion. The graph exists to represent the actual network of official reports and the documented dependencies among them. Coverage stops when additional primary documents stop adding real, verifiable nodes or edges — not when a head-count target is reached. This principle applies to every jurisdiction.

examined_and_not_added.item: Year-End Assessment Roll Report as free-standing node
examined_and_not_added.reason: Advisory package of trends, risk-to-roll, roll-stability and legislative updates delivered to local governments. Useful context but not a recurring titled statistical or financial publication with its own independent cadence under the data-spec. Content is already partially captured by the annual roll, Data Advice and Non-Market Change products.

examined_and_not_added.item: Alberta-style equalized assessment or FIR compilation
examined_and_not_added.reason: Does not exist in BC. Assessment is already uniform and province-wide under BC Assessment. The Local Government Statistics schedules (from LGDE) are the functional equivalent of the compiled municipal financial/statistical product.

examined_and_not_added.item: Forced density parity with other closed countries
examined_and_not_added.reason: Rejected on principle. The graph follows the data that exist and the dependencies that can be evidenced from primary documents. Artificial head-count targets are not part of the model.

proposed_reports.title: Assessment Act [RSBC 1996] c. 20
proposed_reports.description: Core statute requiring annual assessment of all real property at actual (market) value as of July 1, completion of the assessment roll by 31 December, delivery of rolls and notices, and classification into nine property classes.

proposed_reports.title: Assessment Authority Act [RSBC 1996] c. 21
proposed_reports.description: Establishes the British Columbia Assessment Authority as a provincial Crown corporation whose purpose is to establish and maintain uniform real property assessments throughout British Columbia in accordance with the Assessment Act.

proposed_reports.title: BC Assessment Annual Assessment Roll and Property Assessment Notices
proposed_reports.description: Province-wide annual market-value assessment of approximately 2.2 million properties (valuation date 1 July). Roll completed by 31 December; notices mailed in January; authenticated rolls delivered free to municipalities, regional districts and relevant ministries. Sole tax base for municipal, school, regional-district, TransLink, MFA and BC Assessment levies.

proposed_reports.title: BC Assessment Service Plan and Annual Service Plan Report
proposed_reports.description: Three-year service plan prepared under the Budget Transparency and Accountability Act, plus annual report comparing actual results to the plan.

proposed_reports.title: Budget and Fiscal Plan (British Columbia)
proposed_reports.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Province of British Columbia
proposed_reports.description: Primary annual budget document containing the three-year fiscal plan, economic outlook, revenue and expense forecasts, tax measures and capital plan. Accompanied by Estimates, Budget Speech and ministry/Crown service plans.

proposed_reports.title: Public Accounts of the Province of British Columbia
proposed_reports.publisher: Office of the Comptroller General, Ministry of Finance
proposed_reports.description: Audited Summary Financial Statements of the Government Reporting Entity plus Financial Statement Discussion and Analysis. Compares actual results to the Budget and Fiscal Plan. Fiscal year ends 31 March.

proposed_reports.title: Community Charter [SBC 2003] c. 26
proposed_reports.description: Primary municipal governance statute. Part 6 requires every municipality to adopt a five-year financial plan bylaw before the annual property-tax bylaw; Part 7 governs property-value taxes, tax-rate bylaws (deadline before 15 May) and assessment averaging options.

proposed_reports.title: B.C. Economic Accounts and Gross Domestic Product
proposed_reports.publisher: BC Stats, Ministry of Citizens’ Services
proposed_reports.description: Provincial economic accounts translating income, production, capital formation and consumption into a consistent statistical system. Includes GDP by industry (NAICS) in chained and current dollars. Adapted from Statistics Canada provincial accounts with BC Stats processing.

proposed_reports.title: BC Stats Consumer Price Index (CPI) Data Tables and Highlights
proposed_reports.description: Monthly, fiscal-year and annual CPI series and highlights for British Columbia (base 2002=100), produced by BC Stats from Statistics Canada CPI data.

proposed_reports.title: BC Stats Labour Force Survey Highlights and Data Tables
proposed_reports.description: Monthly and annual Labour Force Survey releases for British Columbia (employment, unemployment rate, participation, wages, industry and demographic detail). Adapted from Statistics Canada LFS with BC Stats commentary and tables.

proposed_reports.title: BC Stats Quarterly Population Highlights and Estimates
proposed_reports.description: Quarterly population estimates and component-of-change analysis (natural increase, interprovincial and international migration, non-permanent residents) for British Columbia and sub-provincial areas.

proposed_reports.title: Municipal Finance Authority of British Columbia Annual Report and Financial Statements
proposed_reports.publisher: Municipal Finance Authority of British Columbia (MFA)
proposed_reports.description: Annual report and audited financial statements of the cooperative borrowing authority that provides long-term and short-term financing to municipalities, regional districts and other local public bodies across BC. Appears as a small levy on municipal property-tax bills.

proposed_reports.title: TransLink Accountability Report (with Consolidated Financial Statements)
proposed_reports.publisher: South Coast British Columbia Transportation Authority (TransLink)
proposed_reports.description: Integrated annual accountability report covering social, environmental and financial performance, including audited consolidated financial statements. Taxation revenue (property-tax based) is a major revenue line. Appears as an explicit levy on municipal tax notices that rest on the BC Assessment roll.

proposed_reports.title: TransLink Annual Business Plan / Operating and Capital Budget
proposed_reports.publisher: South Coast British Columbia Transportation Authority (TransLink)
proposed_reports.description: Annual operating and capital budget setting service levels, taxation requirements and capital investment. Taxation revenue is forecast and forms a material share of total revenue.

proposed_reports.title: ICBC Annual Service Plan Report
proposed_reports.description: Annual service plan report comparing actual results to the multi-year service plan, prepared under the Budget Transparency and Accountability Act. Includes financial performance analysis and consolidated financial statements. Major Crown whose net income feeds the provincial Public Accounts and fiscal plan.

proposed_reports.title: ICBC Multi-Year Service Plan
proposed_reports.description: Three-year service plan prepared under the Budget Transparency and Accountability Act, setting performance measures, rate strategy and financial outlook. Consistent with government’s strategic priorities and fiscal plan.

proposed_reports.title: City of Vancouver Operating Budget, Capital Budget and Multi-Year Financial Plan
proposed_reports.description: Annual operating and capital budgets plus multi-year capital plan. Property-tax revenue requirement drives subsequent tax-rate bylaws that rest on the BC Assessment roll.

proposed_reports.title: City of Vancouver Annual Financial Report (audited consolidated statements)
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements prepared under Public Sector Accounting Standards, plus Statement of Financial Information under the Financial Information Act.

proposed_reports.title: City of Vancouver Property Tax Rating Bylaws and Land Assessment Averaging Resolutions
proposed_reports.description: Annual bylaws setting general-purpose and other-authority tax rates per $1,000 of taxable assessed value for each property class, plus targeted land-assessment averaging bylaw.

proposed_reports.title: City of Victoria Five-Year Financial Plan and Annual Budget
proposed_reports.description: Five-year financial plan (most recent 2026–2030) setting operating and capital expenditures and the property-tax revenue requirement. Adopted under the Community Charter before the tax-rate bylaw.

proposed_reports.title: City of Victoria Annual Report (including audited financial statements)
proposed_reports.description: Annual report containing audited consolidated financial statements prepared under the Community Charter and Public Sector Accounting Standards.

proposed_reports.title: City of Surrey Five-Year Financial Plan
proposed_reports.description: Five-year financial plan (2026–2030 and predecessors) setting consolidated operating and capital budgets, utility funds and property-tax requirements. Second-largest municipality in BC by population.

proposed_reports.title: City of Surrey Annual Financial Report
proposed_reports.description: Annual financial report (highlights + full audited statements) and Statement of Financial Information required under the Community Charter and Financial Information Act.

proposed_reports.title: City of Burnaby Five-Year Financial Plan
proposed_reports.description: Five-year financial plan (2026–2030 / 2025–2029) adopted by bylaw under the Community Charter. Sets operating and capital budgets and the property-tax revenue requirement before the annual tax-rate bylaw.

proposed_reports.title: City of Burnaby Annual Municipal Report
proposed_reports.description: Annual municipal report containing audited financial statements prepared under Public Sector Accounting Standards and Statement of Financial Information under the Financial Information Act.

proposed_reports.title: City of Kelowna Financial Plan and Annual Tax Rates Bylaw
proposed_reports.description: Annual financial plan process culminating in a five-year financial plan and property-tax rates bylaw. Provides Interior/Okanagan contrast to Lower Mainland municipalities.

proposed_reports.title: City of Kelowna Annual Report
proposed_reports.description: Annual report prepared under the Community Charter containing audited financial information, performance measures and Council priority results.

proposed_reports.title: City of Prince George Five-Year Operating and Capital Financial Plans
proposed_reports.description: Five-year operating and capital financial plans adopted by bylaw. Provides northern/interior contrast to Lower Mainland and Okanagan municipalities.

proposed_reports.title: City of Prince George Annual Municipal Report
proposed_reports.description: Annual municipal report prepared under the Community Charter, including audited consolidated financial statements and Statement of Financial Information.

proposed_reports.title: Metro Vancouver Budget and Multi-Year Financial Plan
proposed_reports.publisher: Metro Vancouver Regional District (and constituent districts)
proposed_reports.description: Consolidated multi-year financial plan covering water, liquid waste, solid waste, regional parks and related services. Requisitions appear on municipal property-tax bills that rest on the BC Assessment roll.

proposed_reports.title: Capital Regional District (CRD) Multi-Year Financial Plan
proposed_reports.description: Five-year financial plan (and Capital Regional Hospital District companion plan) setting regional, sub-regional and local service budgets and capital programs for the Greater Victoria area. Requisitions flow through to municipal tax bills.

proposed_reports.title: Capital Regional District Annual Report
proposed_reports.description: Annual report highlighting performance against Board priorities together with key financial results. Audited financial statements published separately as required by law.

proposed_reports.title: BC Housing Rental Assistance Program (RAP)
proposed_reports.description: Monthly rent supplement for eligible low-income families with dependent children. Income limit and benefit parameters updated via Budget.

proposed_reports.title: BC Housing Shelter Aid for Elderly Renters (SAFER)
proposed_reports.description: Monthly rent supplement for eligible low-income seniors. Parallel program to RAP with periodic parameter updates.

proposed_reports.title: BC Housing Portable Rent Supplement Program – Rent Ceiling Guide
proposed_reports.description: Periodic guide setting maximum rents by community and bedroom size. Explicitly derived from CMHC Rental Market Survey averages plus 10 % (with anti-decline floors).

proposed_reports.title: BC Hydro Annual Service Plan Report and Financial Statements
proposed_reports.publisher: British Columbia Hydro and Power Authority
proposed_reports.description: Annual service plan report comparing results to the multi-year service plan, plus consolidated financial statements (IFRS) and Financial Information Act return. Major Crown whose net income and capital program feed the provincial Public Accounts and fiscal plan.

proposed_reports.title: Local Government Statistics (Municipal General and Financial Statistics Schedules)
proposed_reports.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Municipal Affairs (Province of British Columbia)
proposed_reports.description: Annual compilation of standardized financial and statistical data submitted by every municipality and regional district via the Local Government Data Entry (LGDE) system. Covers assets, liabilities, long-term debt, revenues, expenditures, tangible capital assets, reserve funds, tax rates and tax burden. Closest functional equivalent to Alberta's Municipal Financial and Statistical Data / FIR compilation. Data due from local governments by 15 May; published in numbered schedules.

proposed_reports.title: Provincial School Tax Rates (Residential and Non-Residential Orders in Council)
proposed_reports.publisher: Province of British Columbia (Orders in Council under the School Act)
proposed_reports.description: Annual residential school-tax rates set by Order in Council for each school district (formula weights number of residences and total residential assessed value) and province-wide non-residential class rates. Includes the Additional School Tax on high-value residential properties (threshold currently $3 million). Rates applied to net taxable assessed values determined by BC Assessment; municipalities and the Surveyor of Taxes collect and remit.

proposed_reports.title: Small Community Grants (Unconditional)
proposed_reports.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Municipal Affairs
proposed_reports.description: Annual unconditional operating grants to municipalities with population up to approximately 19 000. Formula under the Local Government Grants Regulation comprises a base amount, an equalization component driven by assessment weighting factor (provincial average assessment per person divided by the municipality's), and a population component. Parallel to Alberta-style population- and assessment-weighted transfers.

proposed_reports.title: Local Government Grants Act [RSBC 1996] c. 275
proposed_reports.description: Enabling statute for unconditional and conditional grants to municipalities and regional districts. Section 3 authorises unconditional grants to be calculated on population, total expenditures/revenues, converted value of land and improvements (i.e. assessment), or other prescribed bases.

proposed_reports.title: WorkSafeBC Annual Report and Multi-Year Service Plan
proposed_reports.publisher: WorkSafeBC (Workers’ Compensation Board of British Columbia)
proposed_reports.description: Combined annual report and rolling three-year service plan required under the Workers Compensation Act. Reports performance results, financial highlights (premium income, investment returns, claim costs, funding level), and forward-looking priorities. Major Crown whose results appear in the broader provincial fiscal and labour-market picture.

proposed_reports.title: City of Abbotsford Five-Year Financial Plan
proposed_reports.description: Five-year financial plan (e.g. 2025–2029) adopted by bylaw under the Community Charter. Sets operating and capital budgets and the property-tax revenue requirement for the Fraser Valley’s largest city.

proposed_reports.title: City of Abbotsford Annual Report (including Audited Financial Statements)
proposed_reports.description: Annual report required by the Community Charter containing audited consolidated financial statements, management discussion and analysis, and statistical information for the fiscal year ended 31 December.

proposed_reports.title: City of Kamloops Financial Plan / Budget
proposed_reports.description: Annual financial plan and budget setting operating, capital and utility requirements for the largest city in the Thompson-Okanagan / Interior region. Property-tax rates rest on the BC Assessment roll.

proposed_reports.title: City of Kamloops Annual Report and Consolidated Financial Statements
proposed_reports.description: Annual report including audited consolidated financial statements prepared under Public Sector Accounting Standards and the Community Charter, plus statistical and performance highlights.

proposed_reports.title: BC Assessment Data Advice (Completed, Revised and Supplementary Roll Feeds)
proposed_reports.description: Bulk electronic data product delivering the current assessment roll (ownership, legal description, assessed values, classification, sales) to local governments, First Nations and provincial users. Produced at Completed Roll (January), Revised Roll (March/April) and after each supplementary cycle; weekly and monthly update variants also available. The operational feed used by municipalities to set tax rates and maintain tax rolls.

proposed_reports.title: BC Assessment Non-Market Change (NMC) Reporting
proposed_reports.description: Scheduled reporting of value changes on the assessment roll that are not market-driven (new construction, renovations, subdivisions, class changes, exemption changes, boundary changes). Delivered mid-November (target 85% complete) and fully with the Completed and Revised Rolls. Local governments use NMC figures as a source of new tax revenue without rate increases. Available via Self-serve Reports in multiple summary and detail formats.

dependencies.basis: The grant program is authorised by the Local Government Grants Act and the detailed formula (base + assessment-weighting equalization + population) is prescribed in the Local Government Grants Regulation.

dependencies.evidence_quote: "assessment" in relation to a jurisdiction means the converted value of land and improvements, as defined in section 1 of the Schedule to the Community Charter, in the jurisdiction; "assessment weighting factor" in relation to a municipality means the provincial assessment value divided by the per person assessment of the municipality

dependencies.evidence_quote: Grant amounts are based on a formula that incorporates a base amount, population and assessment values.

dependencies.evidence_quote: The assessed values for every taxable property in B.C. is annually determined by BC Assessment. Tax rates are expressed as a dollar figure per $1,000 dollars of assessed property value of land and improvements.

dependencies.basis: The Annual Report presents audited results against the Financial Plan adopted under the Community Charter and includes the statistical schedules derived from that plan year.

dependencies.basis: Non-Market Change values are the component of year-over-year assessment-roll change that is not attributable to market movement. dependencies.evidence_quote: Non-Market Change (NMC) values are reported yearly at mid-November and following the Completed and Revised Rolls. The assessment roll reflects the physical condition and permitted use of properties as of October 31st of the preceding year.

structural_observations: BC Assessment is fully centralized — no municipal assessment offices exist. This is a genuine difference from Alberta and must be preserved.

No province-wide Financial Information Return compilation identical to Alberta’s FIR series. The functional equivalent is: Community Charter financial-plan bylaw → tax-rate bylaw (before 15 May) → audited statements / Statement of Financial Information.
BC Stats is the high-volume statistical layer that creates many natural upward links into the fiscal plan and downward links into municipal and sectoral nodes.
TransLink and MFA appear as explicit levies on municipal tax bills that rest on the BC Assessment roll, creating clean vertical edges.
ICBC and BC Hydro are the two largest Crowns that consolidate into Public Accounts and are explicitly referenced in fiscal variance commentary.
Geographic contrast now spans: Metro core (Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey) + Capital (Victoria + CRD) + Interior (Kelowna) + North (Prince George).
still_thin_or_optional: Richmond, Abbotsford, Kamloops for further municipal densification
Local Area Economic Profiles (LAEP) as a distinct BC Stats product
School-district and hospital-district financial plans / tax levies
Ministry of Housing deeper statistical or evaluation reports
Additional regional districts beyond Metro Vancouver and CRD
